title: HHHusher button
description: A 5px-cornered button with a bold mono capital label. Solid is signal yellow and empties to a yellow outline on hover; glass is a see-through tile for dark backdrops that turns into a cream outline; link is a bare label with a small arrow that dims to 70%. Colours ease over 0.3s.
notes: glass is meant for dark sections (cream at 15%)
exports hhhusherLabel and hhhusherEase class strings for the site's other blocks
